title: Measuring LLM Sycophancy under Sustained Multi-Turn Pressure

bias_targets.methodology: Using a multi-turn dialogue simulation where an LLM proxy adaptively pressures the target model to endorse implicit stereotypes (drawn from the StereoSet dataset, including religious and nationality stereotypes) or to provide discriminatory advice based on group membership. An LLM judge evaluates the responses for sycophantic collapse and discriminatory action.
